thread:
lina-pm: Heads-up: Pegasus SI ran into a blocking failure during marketplace operator install for customer Orion. They hit image pull errors on customer EKS nodes. Go-live Thurs if we can unblock. Need quick arch + escalation.
carlos-se: Can you paste the kubelet / imagepull logs?
lina-pm: From node kubelet: "failed to fetch anonymous token: AccessDenied" then "image pull failed: GetDownloadUrlForLayer AccessDenied". Partner attached cluster logs and the marketplace validation webhook: https://s3.redwood.internal/pegasus/orion/marketplace-3169990001.log
mei-eng: That pattern usually means cross-account ECR + KMS encrypted layers. Are we sure the replicated image landed in the same region and partition?
pegasus-ops: We replicated to eu-west-1 repo `marketplace/pegasus/operator`. Customer cluster in eu-west-1 tried to pull via marketplace flow using role arn:aws:sts::444444444:assumed-role/pegasus-marketplace-pull.
carlos-se: Ok. Two checks: 1) does the replica role have ecr:GetDownloadUrlForLayer + ecr:BatchGetImage for repo ARN, 2) is the image encrypted with a KMS key that allows that external principal to Decrypt?
mei-eng: I'll attempt a repro in our staging account by assuming their role. DM me the assume-role ARN and session creds.
pegasus-ops: DM sent to mei-eng with short-lived creds and the role ARN.
sam-sre: Running staging pull now. Result: AccessDenied on GetDownloadUrlForLayer. After granting scoped ECR read to the replica role the pull moved forward and then failed at KMS:Decrypt. Logs: https://s3.redwood.internal/pegasus/orion/replicate-staging-3169990100.txt
olga-sec: If we add the partner role to the KMS key policy we need a timeboxed exception and org-owner notified. I can approve a temporary entry for validation only, but it must be scoped to the single key and auto-revert.
carlos-se: Minimal IAM snippet I used to repro (scope to repo): ```json
{
  "Effect":"Allow",
  "Action":["ecr:GetDownloadUrlForLayer","ecr:BatchGetImage"],
  "Resource":"arn:aws:ecr:eu-west-1:111111111:repository/marketplace/pegasus/*"
}
```
mei-eng: For the KMS quick test we added the partner principal to key policy with kms:Decrypt and verified the staging pull succeeded.
pegasus-ops: Partner ran marketplace validation in staging and reported success. They ask for a prod canary tonight.
olga-sec: Security ticket SEC-5201 created: 1) approve timeboxed key-policy exception for key `alias/marketplace-eu` for 2 hours, 2) auto-revert and verify, 3) add CloudTrail alert on CrossAccountDecrypt.
sam-sre: I'll own the prod canary and the rollback runbook (revoke key entry + revoke role perms).
pegasus-ops: If we can't get key change approved in time, Pegasus can publish a GovCloud/region-local AMI as a fallback for the customer. It's manual but buys go-live.
lina-pm: Great. Next steps: a) apply scoped ECR perm + temporary KMS entry for test (olga-sec approved), b) run prod canary tonight (sam-sre + carlos-se), c) revert and file follow-up to implement re-encrypt-on-replication (long-term). Confluence notes: https://confluence.redwood.internal/partners/pegasus/orion. Will update this thread after canary. :thumbsup:
